website_info.meta_description: Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics Co., Ltd., simply known as Mindray, is a Chinese multinational health technology company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. Mindray designs and produces medical equipment and accessories for both human and veterinary use. The company is organized into three key business lines: Patient Monitoring & Life Support, In-Vitro Diagnostic Products, and Medical Imaging Systems. In 2008, Mindray was recognized as China's largest medical device manufacturer.

Company name: Mindray

[1] Mindray (company)
Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics Co., Ltd., simply known as Mindray, is a Chinese multinational health technology company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. Mindray designs and produces medical equipment and accessories for both human and veterinary use. The company is organized into three key business lines: Patient Monitoring & Life Support, In-Vitro Diagnostic Products, and Medical Imaging Systems. In 2008, Mindray was recognized as China's largest medical device manufacturer.

As a medical equipment and solutions supplier with a deep focus on healthcare, Mindray strives to develop and share medical technologies and devotes to providing better care for more people across the globe.

[3] Laboratory Diagnostics - Mindray
Mindray empowers this trust through technology, innovation, and our commitment to the advancement of in-vitro diagnostics science. Mindray has developed reliable and robust solutions to empower trust, delivering accurate results while meeting increasing demands on efficiency in laboratories worldwide.
Source: https://www.mindray.com/en/solutions/laboratory-diagnostics

[4] Mindray | Innovative Medical Technology & Diagnostic Solutions
Mindray develops patient monitoring imaging ultrasound and laboratory diagnostic solutions that improve clinical efficiency accuracy and patient care worldwide.
